answer: Because the delta decay is applied at each close, the bridge audit makes public the reduced weight and the seat has to be earned again. A juror that skips cases loses 14% of its weight per missed epoch, so sitting on a seat without doing the work is not a passive strategy. A farm that parks keys in the jury pool as a result watches its influence decay while paying the falcon fee to keep them eligible. Bonded capital sits idle for 3 days. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
